findings.message: Not fixed (the earlier finding was claimed fixed). The screens still use their own 'no owner' rule (`ownerName` is null) instead of `hasNoOwner`. The places are `ProposalPage.tsx:31` (the warn chip), `ProposalsPage.tsx:145`, `ProjectPage.tsx:55,57`, and `proposal-card.ts:90,96` (the From and Owner lines show 'Unassigned'). Meanwhile `attention.ts:32`, `pin-offers.ts:100` and `agent.ts:67` call `hasNoOwner`, which treats a row with an owner_user_id as owned. Fix: decide the chip and the label through `hasNoOwner(p)`. When a row has a user but no name, show that user's name. Add these screens and the card to the AC-1 table test.
findings.scenario: A proposal has owner_user_id set and owner_name null. The detail page shows the 'Unassigned' warn chip and the update card shows 'From: Unassigned'. On the same row, the attention list has no 'Unassigned' need and the pin offers no 'Make me the owner'.

findings.message: Not fixed. 'Is withdrawn' is still written inline several times, and the copies disagree. `tasks.ts:44` and `services.ts:43` test `meta?.withdrawn` for truthiness. `lifecycle.ts:26`, `agent.ts:25` and `queries.ts:47` require `=== true`. `queries.ts:64` (ACTIVE) and `contracts.ts:72` compare `meta->>'withdrawn'` to 'true'. `tasks.ts:82` and `services.ts:118` check only `withdrawn_at` and ignore meta.withdrawn completely. Fix: export one predicate (the one in `lifecycle.ts`, or put it beside `hasNoOwner`) and call it from every TS site. Keep the SQL form in step with it.
findings.scenario: (1) A proposal has meta.withdrawn = "yes" (or 1). tasks.ts:44 refuses to close its task as withdrawn, but lifecycle.ts and ACTIVE treat it as active. (2) A proposal the repo withdrew (meta.withdrawn = true, withdrawn_at null) gets through tasks.ts:82 and services.ts:118, which check only withdrawn_at.

findings.message: Not fixed. 0009 still runs `add column proposal_id uuid references delivery.proposal(id)`. On a fresh install with Delivery switched off, this fails before 0010 can drop the key, so AC-10 ('Time's migrations run with Delivery off') still fails. Fix: remove the `references` clause from 0009, which hasn't merged yet. Keep 0010 as an `if exists` drop for databases that already ran 0009. Separately, `0001_time.sql:31` still references `delivery.project(id)`; that line was there before this change.
findings.scenario: With AMAX_MODULES_DISABLED=delivery on an empty database, Time's migrations stop at 0009 with 'relation delivery.proposal does not exist'.

findings.message: The table for the partial-at-the-bound fix has only two variants. Add at least one more: a viewer who sees some lines but fewer than MAX_LINES by the last batch, where rows past the bound remain. That should give partial true with the lines kept. The REST fix in `ac1-rest.test.ts:85` likewise adds only one new row: assert the `retry-after` header, and check that an error with code 'unavailable' and retryable false also maps to 503.
